name: CWG Plc
source: CWG Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, Financial Summary for the Group page 84, printed in thousands of naira; values stored below as absolute naira. Cost of Sales is the printed Direct costs shown as a magnitude so that Revenue less Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. The previously stored FY2025 column and the all-null H1 2026 column were dropped because no audited FY2025 filing was available and the stored FY2025 figure did not reconcile with the audited FY2024 comparative. EPS is omitted because the printed per-share line does not reconcile with the same summary profit and share capital. | CRON 20261002: EPS added from CWG Plc audited annual report FY2024, note 15 basic earnings per share page 67, printed in kobo as 120.57 (FY2024) and 22.82 (FY2023), stored here in naira as 1.2057 and 0.2282. Ties: stored group net profit FY2024 3,044,060 thousand divided by the note's weighted average 2,524,826 thousand shares equals 1.2057, and FY2023 576,084 divided by 2,524,826 equals 0.2282. The report's own five-year summary on page 86 is the COMPANY series and is not used here. | CRON 20261002: Income rows filled from CWG Plc audited consolidated financial statements FY2024, consolidated statement of profit or loss page 23 (Group column), printed in thousands of naira, stored here as absolute naira. Printed FY2024/FY2023: Other income 237,551 / 129,838; Administrative expenses 5,700,415 / 3,494,758; Exchange gain/(loss) 18,742 / (182,029); Finance costs 95,511 / 84,126; Finance income 62,640 / 15,053; Profit before tax 4,417,183 / 1,131,916. Operating Profit (EBIT) is the implied subtotal Gross profit plus Other income less Administrative expenses plus Exchange gain/(loss), which equals 4,450,054 / 1,200,989, and then EBIT less Finance costs plus Finance income equals the printed Profit before tax exactly for both years. Operating Expenses is that same net charge between Gross profit and EBIT (administrative expenses less other income less exchange gain, 5,444,122 / 3,546,949). Net Finance Costs is finance costs less finance income (32,871 / 69,073). FY2022 to FY2020 are not printed in this statement so those cells stay empty. | CRON 20261004: FY2022 to FY2020 income rows filled from CWG Plc audited consolidated financial statements FY2024, FINANCIAL SUMMARY - GROUP, printed page 82 of the report, columns 2022/2021/2020, printed in thousands of naira, stored here as absolute naira. Printed: Other income 65,235 / 143,874 / 132,550; Administrative expenses (2,883,046) / (2,215,018) / (2,099,710); Exchange loss/(gain) (219,667) / (186,865) / (24,615); Finance costs (55,919) / (48,542) / (97,283); Finance income 5,551 / 9,398 / 504; Profit before tax 741,385 / 616,425 / 547,262; Earnings per share basic 0.19 / 0.18 / 0.18 (the summary prints the per-share lines under a kobo header but the values are naira, since the FY2024 column reads 1.21 against the audited note 15 figure of 120.57 kobo, so FY2022 is 0.19 naira). Same construction as the existing FY2024/FY2023 rows: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross profit + Other income - Administrative expenses + Exchange loss/(gain) (signed as printed, negative for a gain), giving 791,753 / 655,569 / 644,041; EBIT - Finance costs + Finance income then equals the printed Profit before tax exactly for all three years (741,385 / 616,425 / 547,262). Operating Expenses is that same net charge, Gross profit less EBIT (3,037,478 / 2,258,009 / 1,991,775); Net Finance Costs is Finance costs less Finance income (50,368 / 39,144 / 96,779).
